tecnicaOvariosPediatrico: Choose a convex transducer (3-5Mhz) with the patient in the supine position, using the full bladder as an acoustic window. Serial longitudinal scans of the pelvis with the uterus as a landmark should be made by tilting the transducer and scanning through the bladder from the contralateral side. The ovaries are characterized as hypoechoic oval structures in relation to the adjacent tissues, about halfway from the uterus to the iliopsoas muscle. The ovarian vessels can also be used as additional landmarks.  The largest longitudinal (L) and anteroposterior (A) ovarian axis are measured. tecnicaTesticulosPediatrico: The testicles should be examined with a high frequency linear transducer (7-15 MHz). tecnicaPancreasAdulto: The head and pancreatic body are characterized with a convex transducer (2-5 Mhz) in a  transverse section of the upper abdomen, being able to use the left lobe of the liver or the fluid-filled stomach as an acoustic window for its characterization. The measurement of the pancreatic head (located laterally to the right of the portomesenteric confluence and anteriorly to inferior vena cava) is made by calculating its anteroposterior diameter. The pancreatic body should be measured in its middle portion, anterior to the splenic vein. The main pancreatic duct is well depicted and should be measured in its body portion. The pancreatic tail is hardly seen in this anterior approach and the spleen should be used as an acoustic window for its characterization.

tecnicaAlcasIntestinaisAdulto: Initially a curvilinear transducer is used (3 - 5 MHZ). Graded compression is applied in order to displace interposing gas and increase conspicuity of abnormal bowel loops. If wall thickening is detected, a detailed evaluation with both gray-scale and color Doppler is performed with a linear or curved high-frequency (7.5 to 12 MHz) transducer.In patients without acute symptoms at least 6 hrs of fasting can be helpful to minimize excessive gas in the intestinal lumen. tecnicaApendiceAdulto: A linear array transducer (7-12 MHz) is used to gradually compress the right lower quadrant.Gentle gradual pressure is applied to the anterior abdominal wall, resulting in displacement and compression of normal bowel loops. tecnicaBexigaPediatrico: The bladder volume index (BVI) is calculated with a convex transducer first by measuring the maximum length (L) of the urinary bladder on the longitudinal scan, which is obtained from the neck to the fundus of bladder. Then the transducer is rotated 90o counterclockwise and the bladder scanned from superiorly to inferiorly to locate the maximum transverse section. Depth (D) is measured in the midline from anterior to posterior mucosal surface of the bladder. The width (W) is taken perpendicular to D at its mid-point. BVI is calculated from the formula: L x D x W (in centimeters). Bladder wall thickness is measured when the residual volume  is < 10% of the original because its measurement is difficult and least accurate when the bladder is full. Measurement is taken from a zoomed image of the transverse plane of the voided bladder at three points:anterolaterally, laterally and posterolaterally, the the mean is taken from these three measurements. The final index, BVWI, is calculated by the above data from the formula: Maximum BVI / average wall thickness.
